names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro’s line „Sfântul Mucenic Evdemoz din Georgia” for 4 octombrie.

death.note: doxologia.ro: King Rostom, «(1632-1658)», imprisoned him «în 1642» and at last had him strangled; the life gives no year for the death.

attestations.note: Read and not found: days.pravoslavie.ru's 4 октября ст. ст. (civil 17 October 2026) was read on 2026-10-04 and prints sixteen lines, none of them his — and the day does carry a Serbian commemoration marked «(Серб.)», so the Russian does carry other churches' saints here. This stands undocumented rather than as a refusal.
